'''September 2001 Wheat Ridge tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Valhalla's Games, Wheat Ridge, Colorado on 16 September 2001. [[Eric Crennen]] won it. It is known from Eric Crennen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2981">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-21-valhallas-wheatridge-colorado-9-16-01d2981/ valhallas-wheatridge-colorado-9-16-01], DeckTech (Eric "Quakeem" Crennen, 21 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-21-valhallas-wheatridge-colorado-9-16-01d2981/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Valhalla's Games, Wheat Ridge, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Crennen]]
